integrity: The analytic proof reconstructs the nuclear decomposition, trace, essential spectrum and published-criterion application; finite checks are diagnostic only. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to bounded periodic coefficient profiles in complex ell2. Trace-class conclusion is for the squared-modulus Gram difference, not the modulus difference. The published Rhaly Toeplitz membership criterion is used, not reproved. Broader Gram-averaging priority remains a residual risk.
title: Periodic Rhaly modulation: a trace-class Gram sum rule and a Toeplitz modulus
